policyNotes.currentBase: strict_required_status_checks_policy must stay enabled so a PR head contains the live master tip before merge.
policyNotes.reviewThreads: All review threads must be resolved before merge.
policyNotes.approval: Native approval count stays at 0 while the repository has one human owner: GitHub does not count an author's self-approval. Human authorization remains SHA/base-bound through review-window and merge:execute. Raise this value when an independent required reviewer exists.
policyNotes.requiredChecks: App-owned required check names are read from config/agent-workflow.json requiredChecks at evaluation time, not copied here. dossier-acceptance is now in that list; additional_status_checks keeps it only so the resolver can still dedupe older live rulesets. GitGuardian is the only extra external check.
policyNotes.deletion: deletion and non_fast_forward must remain present so master cannot be deleted or force-pushed.
policyNotes.squash: allowed_merge_methods must include squash because merge:execute uses squash. Other methods may remain.
policyNotes.mutation: This file and its checker are read-only. Apply live ruleset changes separately after C3 (so dossier-acceptance exists) and this desired-state is on master.
